content.text:
TASK:
Record a MEMBER INQUIRY capability against MERIDIAN CORE that searches by LAST NAME. (1) Sign on. (2) Open Member Inquiry / Selection. (3) In 'Search by' call choose with option = the searchBy parameter value verbatim (it is the option's underlying value: 'name' or 'number'). (4) Type the query parameter into the Value field. (5) Click Search. (6) A results table appears - use read_table ONCE to capture it into an output named 'matches', requesting exactly these columns: Member No., Name, Shares. (7) Then probe one exceptional state: begin_probe MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, search again for a last name that does not exist such as Zzzznomatch, and declare_outcome MEMBER_NOT_FOUND with a marker you can literally see. (8) declare_done with capability_id 'member.inquire'.

PARAMETERS:
- query (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'query'. — value: "Lovelace"
- searchBy (none): Caller-supplied parameter 'searchBy'. — value: "name"
- operatorId (internal): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_ID) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: "teller1"
- operatorPassword (secret): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)

The application is served at https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com. The browser is currently blank — begin by navigating to the application.

input.intent: Open the MERIDIAN CORE application to begin sign on.

input.description: Signs on to MERIDIAN CORE, opens Member Inquiry / Selection, and searches for members using the 'searchBy' parameter (underlying value 'name' or 'number') and the 'query' value. Returns the results as the 'matches' table (Member No., Name, Shares). Handles the MEMBER_NOT_FOUND outcome when no records match ("No member records matched your search.").
